title: Binding energy per nucleon curve
back: About 8 MeV for most nuclei, peak 8.75 MeV at A = 56. Fission of heavy and fusion of light nuclei both move towards the peak.

title: Nuclear potential energy curve
back: Attractive near 1 fm, repulsive below about 0.8 fm, negligible beyond a few fm.

title: Nuclear radius
back: So nuclear density (≈ 2.3 × 10¹⁷ kg/m³) is the same for all nuclei.

title: Mass defect
back: The nucleus is always lighter than its separate nucleons.

title: Binding energy
back: Energy needed to pull the nucleus completely apart.

title: Q-value of a nuclear reaction
back: Also: total BE of products − total BE of reactants.

title: Fission vs fusion
back: Fission: heavy nucleus splits (U-235 + n, ~200 MeV, reactors). Fusion: light nuclei join at ~10⁷ K (Sun, 26.7 MeV for 4H → He).

title: Nuclear force in four words
back: "S-S-C-S": strongest, short-range, charge-independent, saturating; repulsive below 0.8 fm.
